An exciting opportunity has arisen for a highly skilled Database Developer to join a forward-thinking educational institution in Perth.   This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys working across SQL Server, integrations, reporting, and application development, with the opportunity to have a real impact on how data is used across the business.  
      This role sits at the heart of the Information and Learning Technologies team, where your technical expertise will directly support both business and academic operations. You will be instrumental in designing, developing, and maintaining robust data solutions and digital applications that underpin the organisation's strategic goals. This position offers you the chance to work closely with stakeholders across the school community, ensuring reliable, secure, and scalable technology outcomes. The role is perfect for someone who thrives in a supportive environment that values knowledge sharing, professional growth, and making a tangible impact on student wellbeing 
 
 Play a key role in shaping data-driven decision-making by developing integrated solutions that enhance accessibility, reporting, and analytics across the institution. 
 Enjoy flexible working opportunities within a collaborative team that values professional development, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement. 
 Make a real difference by supporting student wellbeing and academic success through innovative use of technology and data intelligence. 
 
     
  Responsibilities:  
     
 
 Serve as the primary system administrator and subject-matter expert for the key projects, overseeing configuration, user management, data integrity, version upgrades, and module administration. 
 Design, maintain, and optimise database schemas and SQL Server infrastructure to ensure high performance, availability, security, and data quality across all systems. 
 Architect, develop, and manage integrations between core CRM platforms, finance systems, cloud identity providers, and communication tools using APIs (REST/SOAP), middleware, and ETL processes. 
 Develop dashboards, reports, self-service analytics tools, and custom queries using platforms like Power BI, Crystal Reports, SSRS or similar to support strategic planning and operational needs. 
 Champion data quality frameworks by implementing profiling, cleansing, validation routines, and advising stakeholders on evidence-based decision-making. 
 Administer database change management processes including updates, release procedures, backup/recovery strategies while ensuring compliance with privacy legislation and organisational policies. 
 Design, develop, test, deploy and maintain custom web applications or internal tools using modern frameworks (Python/.NET/Node.js) aligned with the institution's technology stack. 
 Collaborate with stakeholders from various departments to gather requirements for digital solutions that extend enterprise system capabilities while ensuring secure coding practices are followed. 
 Create comprehensive technical documentation in partnership with key stakeholders; utilise ticketing systems for request tracking; document all changes thoroughly before implementation. 
 
 Mentor IT staff in best practices for database management and application development while staying abreast of emerging technologies. 
 
 
  Requirements:  
 
 Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering or related discipline is essential for this role. 
 Advanced proficiency in Microsoft SQL Server technologies including T-SQL scripting, query optimisation techniques as well as experience with SSIS/SSRS or equivalent reporting tools is required. 
 Demonstrated ability to design API-based or middleware integrations (REST/SOAP/webhooks/ETL/Wonde) along with strong skills in ASP.NET/PowerShell/scripting languages is necessary. 
 Solid application development experience using one or more programming languages such as Python/C#/.NET/Node.js/PHP is expected. 
 Proven track record delivering business intelligence solutions using Power BI/Tableau/SSRS/Microsoft Fabric/Crystal Reports or similar platforms is highly valued. 
 Comprehensive understanding of data governance principles including privacy legislation (Australian Privacy Act/APP) plus information security best practices is mandatory. 
 Minimum five years experience in senior database administration or application development roles ideally within education or enterprise environments is preferred. 
 Excellent business analysis skills encompassing risk assessment solution design capabilities coupled with outstanding troubleshooting/problem-solving abilities are vital. 
 Exceptional communication skills enabling clear translation of technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders alongside proven stakeholder engagement experience are important attributes. 
 A positive outlook combined with willingness to embrace organisational values around service/integrity/stewardship plus demonstrated commitment to health & safety policies is expected. 
    Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Peoples are encouraged to apply.  
 To apply please click apply or call  Milena Wawrzyniak-Kalyanpur on +61 8 9266 0980 for a confidential discussion.

Established over eighteen years ago, we are a growing Melbourne-based Software Consultancy with a core focus of delivering business-critical digital products to our clients. Our teams work alongside our customers to dissect their complex problems and convert them into value-driven solutions, combining innovative principles in development, design, analysis and quality automation. We utilise Design Thinking and Agile practices to rapidly create customer and business first software, testing and embracing new technologies and trends along the way.

Our Consultants become trusted advisors to our clients, working alongside other client stakeholders to ensure delivery and technical excellence. As a Fabric Consultant, you will lead by example and work hands-on alongside your teammates on delivery - as well as providing high-level guidance and advice to our customers.

Your key responsibilities as a Senior / Lead Consultant - Native Mobile Developer at Fabric:

-Work under autonomy with a self-driven attitude to own problems and deliver solutions
-Understand the complex business and technical problems, learn quickly, understand tradeoffs and communicate a solution
-Capability to research alternative solutions and propose them within given constraints
-Apply different languages and technologies to your projects while coding side by side with other developers on your team
-Implementing continuous delivery practices to accelerate the delivery of new valuable functionality to its intended users
-Applying test-driven development practices to ensure high quality of the software, and reduce future effort and cost on implementing changes to the product
-Mentoring and coaching less experienced mobile engineers in Fabric family and in our clients’ tech teams, hosting tech meetups and our community events to share your expertise with others
-Advising our clients on the right technical decisions and advocating for the right practices to use
-Being an ambassador for Fabric, promoting our values and the practices we use to make sure we build the software right
-Participate in interviewing and recruitment based on business needs
-Generate thought leadership content relevant to your role to support our marketing department in social media activities and meetups

-Optimize existing systems for performance, scalability, and reliability, identifying and resolving bottlenecks and inefficiencies
-Take full ownership of assigned projects or components, proactively identifying areas for improvement and leading technical discussions to enhance solutions
-Provide guidance to junior engineers, sharing expertise to foster a collaborative and high-performing team environment
-Participate actively in architectural and design decisions, demonstrating a strong grasp of software design principles and scalability

-Demonstrated experience providing technical leadership, mentoring, and guiding teams.
-Strong problem-solving skills and ability to tackle complex technical challenges.
-Excellent communication skills for effective collaboration across teams and stakeholders.
-Strong ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

Your key benefits of being a part of the Fabric team:

-A variety of business domains to dive into including retail, finance, construction and logistics

-Collaborating with a team of top notch professionals who are obsessed with value, latest tech and the right way to build a digital product
-Ability to switch projects every 6-12 months to keep you challenged, excited and growing

-Very diverse and inclusive environment where people value feedback, connections and collaboration in a workspace
-Great office in CBD with all the amenities (yet you’re welcome to work remotely on most days!), fun team events, lunches and celebrations

Permanent Ongoing

Strong understanding of business analysis principles and methodologies.
Experience in eliciting, documenting, and analysing user requirements.
Excellent communication, collaboration, and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Experience working in an Agile development environment (a plus).
Experience with user story writing and user acceptance testing (UAT).

SAP Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) Consultant (ICT Business Analyst – ANZSCO 261111)
Blu Pantera Tech Pty Ltd
Fortitude Valley, Brisbane QLD 4006
Full time
$140,000 – $180,000 per year + superannuation

About position
The SAP Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) Consultant is responsible for analysing business requirements, and designing, configuring and implementing SAP EAM solutions that optimise asset management and maintenance processes for clients operating in asset-intensive industries. The role partners with business stakeholders to maximise asset reliability, reduce maintenance costs and support digital transformation through effective SAP EAM solutions, while ensuring project delivery meets quality standards, timelines and client requirements.

Responsibilities
- Consult with clients, users and stakeholders to understand organisational objectives, operational requirements and asset management needs.
- Identify, investigate and analyse business processes, procedures and work practices to determine inefficiencies and opportunities for improvement.
- Define, document and validate functional requirements for SAP solutions supporting asset management and maintenance operations, and recommend process improvements and system enhancements.
- Design, configure and implement SAP Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) solutions aligned with operational requirements and industry best practice, including asset structures, functional locations, equipment records, maintenance notifications, work orders, preventive and corrective maintenance processes, maintenance plans and maintenance strategies.
- Develop functional specifications, data and process models, system documentation and process maps to support SAP solution design, configuration and development.
- Collaborate with technical consultants, developers and project teams to deliver integrated SAP solutions that meet business requirements and technical standards.
- Apply project management methodologies, principles and techniques to develop project plans, estimate costs, allocate resources and manage SAP EAM implementation activities to achieve project milestones and deadlines.
- Develop and execute test plans, including unit, integration and user acceptance testing (UAT), and coordinate data migration, master data validation, system deployment and go-live activities.
- Prepare user documentation, business process documentation and training materials, and deliver formal training to end users.
- Provide post-implementation support, troubleshoot functional issues and monitor SAP EAM processes and performance to identify improvements.
- Act as a central functional reference point throughout project delivery, liaising with clients, users, project managers, developers and cross-functional teams to ensure solutions meet requirements, quality standards and project objectives.

Skills and Qualifications required to perform the above job role
- Tertiary qualification in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Information Systems or a related discipline. 
- SAP certification or relevant SAP EAM/PM training is highly regarded.
- Minimum of 5 years' experience implementing and supporting SAP Enterprise Asset Management (SAP EAM/PM) solutions.
- Strong business analysis skills, with the ability to identify business requirements, analyse processes and develop functional specifications, process models, documentation and test plans.
- Experience in project management, with strong analytical, problem-solving and organisational skills, and the ability to oversee the implementation of complex IT projects.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to effectively engage with technical teams, business stakeholders and end users.

Reporting to the Reporting and Performance Lead the Power BI Analyst will lead the development of reporting solutions that address both immediate business needs and lay the foundation for long-term performance measurement.

You will be accountable for operationalising performance reporting processes across Blue Care's Community Services, covering both financial and non-financial outcomes, including operational, quality, customer, and workforce metrics. You will also be responsible for analysing service performance, identifying improvement opportunities, and delivering practical, data-driven recommendations to enhance outcomes.

About the Role

Delivery of timely, accurate and appropriate business performance reporting solutions to enable strategic level decision making whilst managing security to data at all times

Proactively lead and implement solutions to address data quality-integrity using the tool suites available or being implemented

Proactively lead and develop user requirements, functional specifications with associated timeline commitments to appropriately manage stakeholder expectations

Manage multiple projects simultaneously and execute in a high-pressure environment

Contribute to the maximisation of synergies across BlueCare as a single integrated organisation to improve outcomes for our customers

Actively lead in requirements gathering participate with various stakeholders and implement agreed plans

Actively participate in the design, redesign or development of data solutions to support Business Intelligence solutions

Design, code, test and document new or modifications to reports

Role Requirements

Minimum of 2 years of experience in developing Power BI reports

Experience in data interrogation, business analysis and report writing-creation, business - process improvements

Enterprise Architecture frameworks and the use of Informatica and data lake-data warehouses

Exceptional analytical, conceptual, and problem-solving experience considering the holistic organisational impacts

Demonstrated skills in Power BI, data gateways and design solutions

Has experience or has lead data model development or business process modelling

Employee Benefits: 

Save tax and increase your take home pay by salary packaging your everyday living expenses and bills (up to $15,900) and meal entertainment (up to $2,650) per annum

Career development opportunities with one of the most trusted community and residential care providers in Australia to challenge yourself, grow and make a meaningful difference 

BlueCare is proudly part of the UnitingCare Family, we'd love you to be too

Joining the state's largest network of aged care workers with its over 8,000 strong, bright team in blue, you'll also be welcomed as part of the UnitingCare family. With more than 16,500 staff and 9,000 volunteers across our brands of BlueCare, Lifeline, ARRCS, The Wesley Hospital, Buderim Private Hospital, St Stephen's Hospital, and St Andrew's War Memorial Hospital, you are part of something bigger. Our team are compassionate, inclusive and committed to the work we do, helping people live life in all its fullness.

Child safe, Child friendly 

UnitingCare is committed to being a Child Safe, Child Friendly organisation and will: 

Provide welcoming, safe & nurturing services for children 

Implement measures to prevent child abuse and neglect within our services

Appropriately and immediately address child abuse and neglect if it does occur 

Abide by the Child Safe Standards and adhere to the Reportable Conduct Scheme 

Diversity & Inclusion 

Our approach is simple -everybody is welcome here. At UnitingCare, diversity is at the core of our who we are, our mission and our values. TAG is a Melbourne-based full-service digital marketing agency partnering with businesses to drive growth through strategy, creative, paid media, websites, CRM and digital transformation. Our head office is located in Balaclava, Melbourne, where this full-time position is based.

*Prepare and maintain design documentation, style guides and design systems.

*Conduct website audits and recommend improvements to usability, performance and conversion.
*Stay up to date with emerging web design trends, technologies and industry best practices.

*Proficiency in Figma, Adobe Creative Suite and modern web design platforms such as Webflow.
*Strong understanding of responsive design, accessibility standards and user-centred design principles.
*Excellent communication, organisational and stakeholder management skills.
*Ability to manage multiple projects and deliver high-quality work within deadlines.
